opening.argument: The material directs viewers through an AVAX flash-loan and front-run workflow involving their own wallet and funds. It instructs them to connect MetaMask, send $200 of AVAX to a contract for swap-related gas, and call a flashloan function in Remix. The proposed return is presented as rapid and substantial: profit is said to appear within 30 seconds to one minute, while the speaker describes rapid trading as inflating the coin's value and claims, “So, we went $200. Wow! That was at least a 5x.” The solicitation further says, “TO EARN MORE THAN THE AMOUNT IN THE VIDEO YOU CAN INCREASE GAS FEE,” linking greater payment to greater earnings. The sampled Remix and MetaMask interactions fit this described process, though they do not independently verify the contract code or transaction outcome.
